hero.title: Perform when it matters
hero.lede: Access greater performance through a different perspective.
hero.body: Epiphanies is a boutique people performance consultancy. We help leaders, teams and organisations turn ability and potential into sustainable results — drawing on FTSE boardroom leadership, doctoral research and world-record-breaking sport.
hero.imageAlt: Looking up into the curved atrium of a modern building against a blue sky

whatWeDo.lede: We work with senior executives and their teams on how they think, decide and work together. No generic programmes and no jargon; we offer practical, evidence-based support that produces the “aha” moments our name promises, and delivers lasting improvements.
paragraphs: We combine trusted research with your business context, then work alongside you to turn it into practical action that measurably improves performance.
Since 1999 we have done this in more than 30 countries, with executives in transition, boardrooms in crisis and with strong leadership teams who aspire to be exceptional.

edge.title: The Epiphanies Edge
edge.lede: Plenty of consultancies talk about high performance. We have lived it — three ways.

pillars.title: Proven in practice
pillars.body: We have held the roles we coach, most recently as Group Chief People Officer of a FTSE-listed business, alongside twenty-five years advising boards and executive teams of multinationals.

pillars.title: Grounded in science
pillars.body: Doctoral research into what elite performance actually requires in sport and in business.

pillars.title: Tested at the limits
pillars.body: Proven experience and achievement across industries and ultra-endurance sport (inc. a current World Record)

edge.imageAlt: The Epiphanies Edge — three overlapping fields of experience

items.title: Executive coaching
items.imageAlt: Two colleagues in conversation in armchairs beside a glass wall
items.body: We meet you where you are and provide a confidential space for senior leaders to think clearly, test ideas and shift ingrained patterns with visible impact on how they lead.

items.title: Team & board performance
items.imageAlt: Five colleagues walking and talking along an office atrium walkway
items.body: Through shared understanding, we help executive teams and boards move from competent to exceptional: goal alignment, shared purpose, candid conversations, and the habits of world-class teams.

items.title: Organisation performance
items.imageAlt: Four colleagues walking up a curved staircase beneath a skylight
items.body: Partnering and interventions that build the leaders your business actually needs, designed for your context, grounded in evidence, judged by changed behaviour and performance results.

cta.title: If this sounds like a conversation worth having, we’d like to hear from you.
